title: Nexus Dogu V3 values schema
description: Validates the configurable parts of this chart's values.yaml (ADR-0058). This is a first, pragmatic pass: it constrains the values that are meant to be admin-facing configuration (log level, sizes, resource quantities, pull policies) and deliberately leaves additionalProperties open almost everywhere else, so it doesn't reject legitimate advanced overrides it doesn't yet know about.

name.title: Image pull secret
name.description: Reference to a K8s secret containing image pull credentials for a configured OCI registry.

enabled.title: Enable NetworkPolicies
enabled.description: Whether to create the NetworkPolicies that allow ingress to nexus (from the gateway), to nexus-sa-manager (from the service-account-operator) and to the bundled PostgreSQL (from nexus). Defaults to true.

matchLabels.title: Gateway pod selector labels
matchLabels.description: Labels identifying the k8s-ces-gateway pods, used as the NetworkPolicy ingress selector for reaching nexus-carp.

matchLabels.title: service-account-operator pod selector labels
matchLabels.description: Labels identifying the service-account-operator pods, used as the NetworkPolicy ingress selector for reaching the nexus-sa-manager sidecar.

extraLabels.title: Extra labels
extraLabels.description: Additional labels applied to chart-managed resources.

replicas.title: Replica count
replicas.description: Number of nexus Pod replicas. Nexus is not designed for horizontal scaling - only 0 or 1 is meaningful.

imagePullPolicy.title: Image pull policy
imagePullPolicy.description: Kubernetes imagePullPolicy for the nexus and dogu-init/sa-manager-hooks-init containers.

cpu.title: CPU request
cpu.description: Guaranteed CPU for the nexus container, e.g. 350m or 1.

memory.title: Memory request
memory.description: Guaranteed memory for the nexus container, e.g. 2500Mi.

memory.title: Memory limit
memory.description: Memory limit for the nexus container, e.g. 2500Mi. Keep in sync with config.container_config.java_max_ram_percentage so the JVM heap fits.

size.title: Data volume size
size.description: Size of the PersistentVolumeClaim holding /var/lib/nexus, e.g. 10Gi.

storageClassName.title: Storage class
storageClassName.description: StorageClass for the data PVC. Empty string uses the cluster default.

ports.title: Service ports
ports.description: Named ports exposed by the nexus Service (web/carp and sa-manager). Advanced - only change if you know what you're doing.

configuration.description: doguctl component-mode configuration wiring (ConfigMap/Secret keys). Advanced - only change if you know what you're doing.

normal.title: Nexus/carp configuration
normal.description: Rendered into the doguctl-readable normal-config ConfigMap. These are the admin-facing Nexus/carp settings.

root.title: Root log level
root.description: Log verbosity for Nexus and nexus-carp. Also settable generically via the Dogu-CR's mappedValues.mainLogLevel (see dogu-values-metadata.yaml).

installDefaultDockerRegistry.title: Install default Docker registry
installDefaultDockerRegistry.description: Whether to configure a default Docker registry repository on first start.

maxConnections.title: DB max connections
maxConnections.description: Maximum number of PostgreSQL connections in the pool.

minIdle.title: DB min idle connections
minIdle.description: Minimum number of idle PostgreSQL connections kept open.

java_max_ram_percentage.title: JVM max RAM percentage
java_max_ram_percentage.description: Upper bound of the container memory limit the JVM heap may use, in percent. Keep well under 100 so auxiliary processes (carp, claim, scripting) have headroom.

java_min_ram_percentage.title: JVM min RAM percentage
java_min_ram_percentage.description: Lower bound of the container memory limit the JVM heap may use, in percent.

policy_format.title: Cleanup policy repository format
policy_format.description: Repository format the default cleanup policy applies to, e.g. maven2.

regex.title: Cleanup criteria regex
regex.description: Component name/version regex matched for cleanup, e.g. .*SNAPSHOT.

release_type.title: Cleanup release type
release_type.description: Whether the policy targets PRERELEASES or RELEASES.

days_till_recognition_for_delete.title: Cleanup age (days)
days_till_recognition_for_delete.description: Minimum component age in days before it becomes eligible for cleanup.

enabled.title: Enable compact blobstore task
enabled.description: Whether to schedule the periodic blobstore-compaction task.

blobstore.title: Blobstore name
blobstore.description: Name of the blobstore the compaction task targets.

cron.title: Compaction schedule
cron.description: Quartz cron expression for when the compaction task runs.

token-rate.title: carp rate limiter: token rate
token-rate.description: Tokens (requests) per second nexus-carp's rate limiter refills.

burst-size.title: carp rate limiter: burst size
burst-size.description: Maximum burst of requests nexus-carp's rate limiter allows.

clean-interval.title: carp rate limiter: cleanup interval (s)
clean-interval.description: Interval in seconds at which nexus-carp evicts stale rate-limiter buckets.

logLevel.title: sa-manager log level
logLevel.description: Log level of the service-account-producer-sidecar's own slog logger. Independent of nexus.configuration.normal.logging.root, which only controls Nexus/carp logging.

replicas.title: Replica count
replicas.description: Number of PostgreSQL Pod replicas. The bundled PostgreSQL runs as a single instance and does not support replication - only 0 or 1 is meaningful.

username.title: PostgreSQL username
username.description: Database user nexus connects with. Changing this on an existing installation requires a manual DB migration.

database.title: PostgreSQL database name
database.description: Database name nexus connects to. Changing this on an existing installation requires a manual DB migration.

size.title: PostgreSQL data volume size
size.description: Size of the PersistentVolumeClaim holding the PostgreSQL data directory, e.g. 5Gi.

storageClassName.title: PostgreSQL storage class
storageClassName.description: StorageClass for the PostgreSQL data PVC. Empty string uses the cluster default.
